body_text:
A function is analytic at $z_0$ if it agrees with a convergent
power series on some neighborhood of $z_0$. Analyticity is a
local property: both the coefficients and the radius may depend
on the center. The coefficients are uniquely determined by
$a_n=f^{(n)}(z_0)/n!$.
